name: Glass puzzle pieces
what: Glass puzzle pieces on a pale page: the first rises from below and settles upright with a curly leader line and a label fading in; the next pieces slide in from the right and snap into the one before while the view pulls back, each with its own leader and label. The motion is stepped like the original. The number of pieces, the labels and the colour are yours.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: stepped (8 new pictures in every 15 frames); f10-f42 the first piece rises from below the frame tilted 21 degrees and settles upright (decelerating); f33-f57 its curly leader is drawn, f44-f58 its label fades in word by word; f57-f92 the second piece slides in from the right and snaps into the first while the camera pans left and pulls back about 7 % (f59-f90), its leader f84-f104 and label f104-f116; f112-f149 the third piece slides in the same way (the camera stays), its leader f137-f160 and label f160-f171; then everything holds to f246
